description: check_anomaly returns Some(AnomalyFlag) if and only if efficiency_ratio < threshold OR total_calls > historical_avg × multiplier; reason is LowEfficiency, ExcessiveCalls, or Both accordingly; returns None when neither condition holds

preconditions.description: A completed task analysis provides efficiency_ratio, total_calls, and historical_avg_calls

expectedOutcome.description: Anomaly flag is raised with correct reason when thresholds are exceeded, and no flag is raised when within normal bounds
